tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description:
List campaigns.
Required API key scope: campaigns:read.
GET /campaigns
Returns non-archived campaigns, newest first. With `archived=true`, returns only ARCHIVED campaigns (and `folderId` is ignored).

folderId.description: Folder id, or `root` for items not in any folder.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description:
Create a campaign.
Required API key scope: campaigns:write.
POST /campaigns
Creates a DRAFT campaign with templates, follow-ups, accounts and audiences, and creates a PENDING
recipient for every (deduplicated) member of the given audiences. `timezone` is accepted but ignored:
the user's account timezone is used. Validation errors are reported as `"<field>: <message>"`.

timezone.description: Ignored; the user's timezone is used.

tools.name: get_campaign
update_campaign
tools.description:
Update a campaign.
Required API key scope: campaigns:write.
PATCH /campaigns/{id}
Partial update. Setting `status: ACTIVE` requires at least one template, a primary audience with members,
and at least one ACTIVE account. Passing `audienceIds` replaces the audiences and adds recipients for new
members (existing recipients are kept). Passing `accountIds` replaces the accounts. `timezone` is ignored.

tools.name: delete_campaign
get_campaign_stats
tools.description:
Get campaign stats.
Required API key scope: campaigns:read.
GET /campaigns/{id}/stats
`totalPending` counts PENDING + QUEUED. `replyRate` is round(replied / (sent + replied) * 100).

tools.name: list_campaign_recipients
tools.description:
List campaign recipients.
Required API key scope: campaigns:read.
GET /campaigns/{id}/recipients
Returns all recipients (unpaginated).

status.description: Filter by recipient status; `ALL` or omitted for all.

tools.name: retry_campaign
tools.description:
Retry failed recipients.
Required API key scope: campaigns:write.
POST /campaigns/{id}/retry
Resets FAILED recipients to PENDING. A COMPLETED campaign with at least one retried recipient is set back to ACTIVE.

tools.name: list_audiences
tools.description:
List audiences.
Required API key scope: audiences:read.
GET /audiences

folderId.description: Folder id, or `root` for items not in any folder.

tools.name: create_audience
tools.description:
Create an audience.
Required API key scope: audiences:write.
POST /audiences

tools.name: get_audience
update_audience
tools.description:
Update an audience.
Required API key scope: audiences:write.
PATCH /audiences/{id}
Only the listed fields are applied; there is no schema validation. Empty `description` / `folderId` become null.

tools.name: delete_audience
tools.description:
Delete an audience.
Required API key scope: audiences:write.
DELETE /audiences/{id}
Fails with 409 if an ACTIVE campaign uses it as its primary audience; otherwise unlinks it from other campaigns and deletes it.

tools.name: list_audience_members
tools.description:
List audience members.
Required API key scope: audiences:read.
GET /audiences/{id}/members
Paginated, newest scraped first. `search` matches username, full name or bio (case-insensitive).

tools.name: import_audience_members
tools.description:
Import members.
Required API key scope: audiences:write.
POST /audiences/{id}/import
Three input forms: JSON with a single `username` (plus optional profile fields), JSON with a
`usernames` string array, or a multipart CSV `file` (required column `username`/`instagram_username`/
`ig_username`; optional `full_name`, `followers`, `following`, `bio`, `last_post_date`). Leading `@` is
stripped. Max 10,000 per import. Existing members are left untouched but still counted in `imported`.

file_path.description: Path to a local file, uploaded as the multipart `file` field. Use either this or `body`.

tools.name: export_audience
tools.description:
Export members as CSV.
Required API key scope: audiences:read.
GET /audiences/{id}/export
Columns: `username,fullName,followerCount,followingCount,bio,isVerified`. Sent as an attachment.

tools.name: start_audience_scrape
tools.description:
Start scraping.
Required API key scope: audiences:write.
POST /audiences/{id}/scrape
Queues a scrape of the audience source using the given Instagram account and sets status to SCRAPING.

tools.name: stop_audience_scrape
tools.description:
Stop scraping.
Required API key scope: audiences:write.
DELETE /audiences/{id}/scrape
Signals the scrape job to stop and marks the audience COMPLETE.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description:
List conversations.
Required API key scope: conversations:read.
GET /conversations
Paginated, most recent message first.

tools.name: refresh_conversations
tools.description:
Sync inboxes.
Required API key scope: conversations:write.
POST /conversations/refresh
Synchronously syncs the inbox of every account that has an open (SENT/READ/REPLIED) conversation.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description:
Get a conversation.
Required API key scope: conversations:read.
GET /conversations/{id}
Returns the conversation with all messages (oldest first). Side effect - marks unread inbound messages as read (the returned messages still show their prior `isRead`).

tools.name: update_conversation
send_conversation_reply
tools.description:
Send a text reply.
Required API key scope: conversations:write.
POST /conversations/{id}/reply
Sends via the worker and waits up to 20 s for Instagram to confirm, then returns the stored message.

tools.name: send_conversation_photo
tools.description:
Send a photo.
Required API key scope: conversations:write.
POST /conversations/{id}/photo
Queues a photo send; the message appears in the conversation once the worker delivers it.

file_path.description: Path to a local file, uploaded as the multipart `photo` field.

tools.name: export_conversation_lead
tools.description:
Export as lead.
Required API key scope: conversations:write.
POST /conversations/{id}/crm
Builds a lead (enriched from the matching audience member, last 5 messages), fires the `lead.imported`
webhook event, optionally POSTs the lead to `webhookUrl` (failures ignored), and returns it as JSON or CSV.
The body is optional.

tools.name: delete_conversation_message
tools.description:
Delete (unsend) a message.
Required API key scope: conversations:write.
DELETE /conversations/{id}/messages/{messageId}
Deletes the message locally and, when possible, queues a best-effort unsend on Instagram.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description:
List Instagram accounts.
Required API key scope: accounts:read.
GET /accounts

folderId.description: Folder id, or `root` for items not in any folder.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description:
Add an Instagram account.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /accounts
Queues a login job. A proxy (`proxyId` or inline `proxy`) is required in production. The login may need
2FA or a challenge (see `verifyAccount2fa` / `verifyAccountChallenge`). Body validation uses a throwing
parse, so a malformed body yields a 500 rather than a 400.

tools.name: get_login_status
tools.description:
Poll a login job.
Required API key scope: accounts:read.
GET /accounts/login-status
Status of a job returned by createAccount, reloginAccount or checkAccountSession.

tools.name: get_accounts_proxy_health
tools.description:
Proxy health per account.
Required API key scope: accounts:read.
GET /accounts/proxy-health
Tests each account's proxy (results cached for 10 minutes). Keyed by account id.

tools.name: verify_account_2fa
tools.description:
Submit a 2FA code.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /accounts/verify-2fa
Continues a login that required two-factor auth. `identifier` and `partialSession` come from the login job result. Malformed bodies yield 500.

tools.name: verify_account_challenge
tools.description:
Submit a challenge code.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /accounts/verify-challenge
Continues a login that hit an Instagram checkpoint. `checkpointUrl` and `partialSession` come from the login job result. Malformed bodies yield 500.

tools.name: get_account
update_account
tools.description:
Update an account.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
PATCH /accounts/{id}
No schema validation; only the listed fields are read. If `forceRelogin` is true and `username` + `password`
are given, credentials are replaced and a re-login is queued (202). Otherwise fields are updated (200).
In production a proxy cannot be removed (only replaced) and warmup requires a proxy.

userAgent.description: Ignored (set to null) unless it is a known user agent.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description:
Delete an account.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
DELETE /accounts/{id}
Returns success even if the account does not exist.

tools.name: check_account_session
tools.description:
Check the Instagram session.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /accounts/{id}/check-session
Queues a session check; the account status is updated by the worker.

tools.name: relogin_account
tools.description:
Re-login with stored credentials.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /accounts/{id}/relogin

tools.name: set_account_listening
tools.description:
Toggle inbox listening.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
PATCH /accounts/{id}/listening
When enabling, runs a one-time inbox sync and returns its result.

tools.name: get_account_warmup_history
tools.description:
Warmup history by day.
Required API key scope: accounts:read.
GET /accounts/{id}/warmup-history
Last 500 warmup log entries grouped by UTC date, newest first.

tools.name: get_account_warmup_status
tools.description:
Warmup status and recent logs.
Required API key scope: accounts:read.
GET /accounts/{id}/warmup-logs
Last 50 logs, today's schedule and progress, and upcoming warmup sessions.

tools.name: list_proxies
tools.description:
List proxies.
Required API key scope: accounts:read.
GET /proxies

tools.name: create_proxy
tools.description:
Add a proxy.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /proxies
Malformed bodies yield 500 (throwing parse).

tools.name: update_proxy
tools.description:
Update a proxy.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
PATCH /proxies/{id}
Returns success even if no proxy matched.

tools.name: delete_proxy
tools.description:
Delete a proxy.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
DELETE /proxies/{id}
Returns success even if no proxy matched.

tools.name: test_proxy
tools.description:
Test a proxy.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
POST /proxies/{id}/test
Fetches the exit IP through the proxy (always as an HTTP proxy) and records the result.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description:
List folders.
Required API key scope: campaigns:read | audiences:read | accounts:read.
GET /folders
Required scope depends on `type`: CAMPAIGN → `campaigns:read`, AUDIENCE → `audiences:read`,
ACCOUNT or omitted → `accounts:read`. Without `type`, folders of all types are returned. Returns
root folders unless `parentId` is given.

parentId.description: Parent folder id; `root` or omitted for root folders.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description:
Create a folder.
Required API key scope: campaigns:write | audiences:write | accounts:write.
POST /folders
Required scope depends on body `type`: CAMPAIGN → `campaigns:write`, AUDIENCE → `audiences:write`,
ACCOUNT → `accounts:write`. The body is validated before authentication, so a bad body returns 400 even
without credentials. A duplicate name under the same parent violates a unique constraint (500).

tools.name: update_folder
tools.description:
Rename or move a folder.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
PATCH /folders/{id}
Requires `accounts:write` regardless of the folder's type.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description:
Delete a folder.
Required API key scope: accounts:write.
DELETE /folders/{id}
Requires `accounts:write` regardless of type. Items inside move to root; child folders move to this folder's parent.
